scope: Remediate O05 notification evidence identity without changing signal, delivery, retry, SQL, scheduler, API, UI, or production behavior.

files.role: advisory insert, retry RPC call, and delivery status persistence
claim outcome branching and sendSignalEmail boundary

attemptCount.retryCompareAndSet: FAILED and p_now < signal_valid_until and attempt_count < 2; increments by one
attemptCount.skipPaths: SKIPPED_DUPLICATE and SKIPPED_EXPIRED do not mutate attempt_count
attemptCount.currentMetadataGap: The retry RPC returns only the outcome string and skip paths return no attempt count.

scanIdentity.scanId: Stable public.tp_scan_runs.id for the logical scan run; reused by scan-run retry
scanIdentity.runKey: Deterministic hourly run key used to find the scan row; notification identity uses the authoritative scanId

identity.decisionEvent: Every claim outcome is one notification decision event, including skipped decisions.

collisionAnalysis.differentScanRuns: Different scanId values produce different identities.
collisionAnalysis.initialAndRetry: CLAIMED and RETRY_CLAIMED remain distinct even for the same scanId and signalId.
collisionAnalysis.replay: The same scanId, signalId, channel, and outcome reproduce the same identity and are an idempotent replay.

deliveryAndDecision.deliveryAttempt: A delivery attempt exists only after CLAIMED or RETRY_CLAIMED and immediately before sendSignalEmail().
deliveryAndDecision.decisionEvent: All four claim outcomes are decision events.
deliveryAndDecision.deliveryAndTerminalLink: Both terminal outcomes reference the same notificationDecisionId.
deliveryAndDecision.terminalUniqueness: One terminal identity per notificationDecisionId; a delivery attempt cannot be both delivered and failed.

skipMapping.SKIPPED_EXPIRED: SUPPRESSED with suppressionReason=EXPIRED; no email attempt

deliveryAndDecision.deliveryFailure: Technical delivery failure is a separate terminal event linked to the same delivery attempt decision.
deliveryAndDecision.ignored: IGNORED remains INSTRUMENTATION_UNRESOLVED unless explicit human or UI evidence exists.

attemptSequence.role: Diagnostic delivery-attempt metadata only; not an identity component.

RETRY_CLAIMED.source: retry RPC compare-and-set increments attempt_count; future metadata must expose post-CAS state

SKIPPED_DUPLICATE.source: Not applicable to a skipped decision

SKIPPED_EXPIRED.source: Not applicable to a skipped decision

fields.notificationDecisionId: Deterministically derived from scanId, signalId, channel, and outcome
fields.attemptSequence: 1 for CLAIMED, 2 for RETRY_CLAIMED, null for skip outcomes

gates.rule: All four runtime claim outcomes are explicitly enumerated.
attempt_count semantics are proven for initial insert, retry CAS, and non-mutating skips.
Delivery start and terminal evidence share the delivery claim decision identity.
Every claim outcome has deterministic identity from authoritative scan and claim fields.
Logical replay is idempotent and does not use capture time or randomness.
The frozen identity preimages separate runs, outcomes, and terminal events.
The proposed envelope is additive and behavior-preserving; implementation remains future work.

o05.reason: The design supplies deterministic decision identity without guessing unavailable attemptSequence values.
